scope: Full completed A/B/C coverage: 50 cases per arm, plus all 7 archived C initialization failures. No provider calls were made by this audit.
method: Read saved result JSON only. Tool calls and visible responses come from stepsTaken, not final self-report. Manual attribution is separate from factual grading.
limitations: Saved agent step summaries contain truncated response bodies despite verbose retrieval. This does not establish whether the model saw truncated data.
Visible evidence paths are not causal estimates. A/B/C vary in generated queries and sampling; C also changes the prompt.
Content gaps differ from transport/API errors. Error counts cover only explicit visible strings.
Zero Keenable calls means no direct retrieval contribution. Differences between answers can still reflect stochastic native research.
cross_case_findings: B made no Keenable call in 40 of 50 cases, so those answer differences cannot be credited to direct Keenable retrieval.
MNTN shows same-URL page-fetch recovery after a native execution error. Red Canary shows useful fallback after an empty native search. Both have matching A/B target facts.
Pennylane failed to recover requested facts using either native or Keenable fetch on the same TCV URL.
Verona Pharma shows that successful retrieval can feed an out-of-scope public financing answer.
Saved agent step summaries contain truncated response bodies despite verbose retrieval. This limits evidence attribution; it does not establish what the model saw.
C called Keenable search in all 49 funding/lifecycle cases. All 50 C cases began with native research; the Freeman entity probe omitted Keenable without an observed need for verification.

C initial MCP setup failed under the public 10 RPS limit in seven attempts before model research. These failures have zero observed data/action credits and were retried once with two-second submission spacing. Their transport errors are separate from errors returned by research calls.

C still exceeded the eight-call prompt instruction in nine cases and made more than six native calls before its first Keenable call in eight cases. Tool order compliance and factual usefulness must be reported separately.

Lessn has a visible Keenable-origin later-funding discovery. Abridge has a visible Keenable discovery lead corroborated by native Fortune fetch. Wayve has native-confirmed extension evidence with unresolved Keenable discovery attribution. Source adjudication determines correctness.
Circle C shows a native SEC extraction contamination retained in financing fields; mandatory Keenable verification did not repair it.
